meta.title: SSO Authentication: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as a Tenant Admin on the Growth-plan tenant and verify that SSO Authentication is absent or refused.
Repeat the same SSO Authentication flow on the Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it is available and works.
Compare the capability outcome across the two plan tenants using the same user role and steps.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a Tenant Admin on the Growth-plan tenant and verify that SSO Authentication is absent or refused.; Repeat the same SSO Authentication flow on the Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it is available and works.; Compare the capability outcome across the two plan tenants using the same user role and steps.

args.need: sign in as the Tenant Admin on both the Growth-plan and Enterprise-plan tenants, try SSO Authentication on each, and report whether it is absent or refused on Growth and available and working on Enterprise

steps.note: No catalog step can perform the required role-specific sign-in, identify tenants by plan, or inspect and use the SSO Authentication capability.
Checks that the session has not shown a generic application error after the tester's investigation, but does not assert SSO availability.
